notes: And when is read as one rendering of the opening waw (rule 55), headed on the coordinator; the competing head is when.
וַיָּשָׁב serialized with וַיִּשְׁלַח is rendered adverbially by again, and the ASV writes no connective for either waw, so both are unrepresented (rule 14).
אִתָּךְ is the preposition H854, not the object marker (rule 16).
